notes: This phase produces a renderer-independent semantic LOD render plan from primary Person tracks.
World zoom exposes unique Person density sources rather than every Person name.
Regional zoom introduces Person points and one label candidate per visible Person; higher zoom introduces historical rails and Activity glyph metadata.
Layer opacity cross-fades continuously as camera detail changes; no separate overview/detail mode button is required by the v2 architecture.
Label candidates remain anchored to real projected Person segments. Phase 8 will resolve screen-space collisions without moving historical time coordinates.
Production v1 remains authoritative until the later cutover.
